game.name: Command and Conquer 3 : Tiberium Wars (Europe)
game.desc: Command & Conquer 3 is a strategy game for Xbox 360. Command the NOD or the GDI and fight your enemy to establish your army on earth. Build your bases, your men and your weapons to defeat your opponents. Playable in LAN and online multiplayer, C&C 3 has many surprises in store, such as the possibility of managing a new alien faction, the Scrins...
